artworks.title: Hussars Riding Single File
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam
artworks.description: The image shows horse-mounted figures in motion across an open landscape. The horizon line is low in the image, almost level with the mounted figures, and the sky above them is vast. The artwork features rough brushstrokes that convey movement and texture, with a focus on linear patterns and shading. The color palette is predominantly sepia-toned, with dark browns and faded off-whites. The ground is depicted with detailed strokes suggesting grass or low vegetation, which continues into the area just beyond the horses and riders.

artworks.title: Scene with Horses Standing in Stream
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Rijksmuseum, Amsterdam
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with figures and a horse in a sketchy, monochromatic style. Buildings or structures are seen in the background, with no visible horizon. The composition conveys a sense of spontaneity and immediacy through varied lines and textures.

artworks.title: The Donkey Cart
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey as an addition to the Addie Burr Clark Memorial Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a donkey harnessed to a cart. The drawing shows a donkey fitted with a harness, standing in profile view, connected to a wooden cart that is partially shown. The cart holds baskets and other goods. The use of shadings and lines suggests depth and texture, bringing out the form and musculature of the donkey, as well as the details of the cart's construction. The simplistic yet expressive style gives the drawing a sense of movement and life.

artworks.title: Jean 1923
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
image (irregular): 23.5 × 18.1 cm (9 1/4 × 7 1/8 in.)
sheet: 30.5 x 24.1 cm (12 x 9 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey as an addition to the Addie Burr Clark Memorial Collection
artworks.description: The image is a portrait drawing of a young girl. She is facing slightly to the right with large, dark eyes and a small, slightly upturned mouth. Her hair is medium length with straight bangs across her forehead and flows down past her shoulders with a slightly wavy texture. She is wearing a garment with a high collar adorned with a round decorative pin or brooch, a ribbon tied in a bow, and a scalloped edge with ruffled details. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Under the Horse-Chestnut Tree
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey as an addition to the Addie Burr Clark Memorial Collection
artworks.description: The image shows an adult and a child in an outdoor setting. The adult is seated, while the child is held upright on their lap. They are surrounded by grass and there are leafy branches above them, suggesting they may be under a tree. The adult has long brown hair and is wearing a blue top and a yellow skirt. The child has short, curly, blonde hair and appears nude.

artworks.title: The Letter
artworks.medium: color drypoint, softground etching, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey as an addition to the Addie Burr Clark Memorial Collection
artworks.description: We look slightly down onto a young woman sitting at a writing desk as she licks an envelope in this vertical, color print. A table folds down or extends from a tall secretary desk to our right. The blotter on the table and the woman’s long dress are both royal blue. The dress has a vaguely floral pattern in the cream-white of the paper, and the jacket is open to reveal a vertically pleated, beige-pink shirt beneath. The woman’s skin is also the color of the paper. Her black hair is pulled back over dark brows and a delicate nose. She holds the open flap of the envelope to her mouth with both hands. A piece of white paper lies on the desktop in front of her. She sits in a brown chair, and the wallpaper of the room is patterned with green leaves against a white background. The sheet is inscribed with graphite across the right half of the bottom margin, “Imprimée par l’artiste et M. Leroy Mary Cassatt (25 épreuves)."

artworks.title: The Banjo Lesson
artworks.medium: color drypoint and aquatint with monoprint inking on Japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey as an addition to the Addie Burr Clark Memorial Collection
artworks.description: This print shows two women sitting together. The woman in the front is seated, holding a banjo, with her body turned to us and her face looking to the right. The neck of the banjo points to the right. The woman in front has dark hair styled neatly behind her head, dark eyebrows, long eyelashes, and lips set in a neutral expression. She is wearing a long-sleeved dress with puffy teal sleeves, a white and light blue striped bodice, and a light blue skirt with pink polka dots, with a yellow scarf around her neck. Her arms are positioned around the banjo. The second woman sits behind her, her hands on the banjo player's shoulders, watching her play. This woman has lighter colored hair with short bangs, and wears a light pink dress. She appears younger than the other woman. Both of them have pale yellow skin. The background is plain beige paper.

artworks.title: The Bathers (Small Plate)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey as an addition to the Addie Burr Clark Memorial Collection
artworks.description: This painting depicts abstract figures in a natural setting. The figures have elongated forms and simplified features. They are situated among greenery with a focus on fleshy tones against a green backdrop suggestive of trees. The figures appear to be in relaxed or contemplative postures. The style is reminiscent of an impressionist or post-impressionist approach to portraying human figures in nature, similar to Paul Cézanne's work.

artworks.title: Against Green
artworks.medium: color softground etching and aquatint on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey as an addition to the Addie Burr Clark Memorial Collection
artworks.description: The painting shows abstract forms suggesting intertwining figures amidst a natural backdrop. Three figures are depicted on a textured green and earthy background resembling a forest. The figures appear to be engaged in a gentle, fluid interaction, with soft muted tones contrasting the darker background. The style is reminiscent of Arthur B. Davies, featuring dreamlike and serene treatment of the figures.

artworks.title: Release at the Gates
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey as an addition to the Addie Burr Clark Memorial Collection
artworks.description: The image shows soft, flowing lines and undulating shapes forming an abstract composition. There are human-like figures in motion or dance with fluid postures. The scene has an ethereal quality with gentle blending of colors and lines, creating a dream-like gathering. The figures appear to float or interact harmoniously with each other.

artworks.title: Jockey
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey as an addition to the Addie Burr Clark Memorial Collection

artworks.title: Breton Bathers (Baigneuses Bretonnes)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey as an addition to the Addie Burr Clark Memorial Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with a slight turn to the side, looking over their left shoulder. The figure is nude, with their back mostly visible and their right arm bent at the elbow. The person has short dark hair and a profile face with a slightly pointed nose and soft cheek curve. The background is abstract and textured, with dark and light shades. In the lower left corner, there are artistic strokes resembling clothing or decorative elements. The setting lacks detail, drawing focus to the person's form and posture. The artwork is signed by P. Gauguin at the bottom left corner.

artworks.title: Disparate femenino (Feminine Folly)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey as an addition to the Addie Burr Clark Memorial Collection
artworks.description: This is a painting of figures engaging in a playful activity with a blanket. The artwork showcases a group of figures surrounding and holding a large piece of cloth or blanket. One of the figures appears to be airborne, in a dynamic pose, as if being tossed or jumping upwards with the help of the cloth. The figures around the blanket are dressed in long garments. The scene conveys motion and interaction among the figures. The background is plain, drawing attention to the activity in the foreground.

artworks.title: Bringing Goats to Market
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey as an addition to the Addie Burr Clark Memorial Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with people and animals. The perspective is slightly elevated, showing a landscape with figures and animals. The composition directs the viewer's gaze upwards, where faint outlines of people and structures create depth. The artwork features sketchy and expressive brushstrokes or etching lines, conveying movement. The color palette includes earthy tones with hints of warm colors. In the foreground, goats move, with figures guiding them. In the distance, another figure tends to the animals. A donkey is visible on the far left. The background shows blended colors, representing the environment without specific details.

artworks.title: At the Concert (Au concert)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey as an addition to the Addie Burr Clark Memorial Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman and a man from the waist up in a side-by-side position. The woman on the left is in three-quarter profile, wearing a large, dark, feathered hat and a voluminous fur coat. Her hair is styled in soft waves visible from beneath the hat. The man on the right is in profile, wearing a formal suit with a top hat, a bow tie, and a boutonniere on his lapel. The image has a pinkish background and includes a visible signature or monogram, along with a handwritten inscription.

artworks.title: Family in a Surrey
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey as an addition to the Addie Burr Clark Memorial Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of two people from the side, seated on an object resembling a seat. The view is from behind and to the side, highlighting the upper half of their bodies. The person on the left is in a slightly turned position, leaning forward with a visible smile. They have dark hair styled with a parting. The other person is seated to the right, with their back partially visible. They wear a dark hat and a long coat or jacket. The drawing style is sketch-like, with lines and curves suggesting motion, and the background consists of hatching and minimal linework.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Hans Holbein the Elder
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image displays two figures in the center. The left figure is kneeling with wings, curly hair, holding a staff with a scroll. The figure on the right is standing/seated with long hair, draped clothing, and a serene expression. They are surrounded by a structured interior with a table and a framed painting on the wall.

artworks.title: The Triumph of the Church
artworks.medium: tempera and gold leaf on vellum
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection

artworks.title: Christ and the Virgin Enthroned with Forty Saints
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene featuring numerous figures. The central panel of the artwork is filled with a group of figures wearing halos and vibrant robes. At the top of the painting, two figures are seated on thrones with symbols surrounding them. The image is framed with a border of circular portraits and decorative elements, including angels and celestial motifs. Gold is used to highlight areas, enhancing its theme. The style is reminiscent of an illuminated manuscript, common in medieval religious art.

artworks.title: Two Friars on a Hillside [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image displays an overhead view of a natural scene with a gentle slope. The horizon is unclear, blending with the top of the slope where trees are located. The style is defined by flowing pen strokes detailing bare trees and ground textures. The color scheme consists of earthy tones on aged paper. Two small human figures appear close by, interacting, with trees ascending the slope nearby. In the distance, a few architectural structures, potentially a small building, are visible amidst sparse foliage and curved landscape lines.

artworks.title: Bare Tree [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of a tree viewed straight-on, with no visible horizon. The tree trunk is depicted with textured lines, and the branches extend outwards with intricate lines, creating a sparse canopy. The style features precise linework that follows the forms of the tree. The color palette is minimal, with the paper's neutral tone as the background and dark lines for the tree. A stark contrast is created between the lines and the paper, emphasizing the tree's form.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 19.5 x 14.2 cm (7 11/16 x 5 9/16 in.)
support: 29 x 23.2 cm (11 7/16 x 9 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image is a side profile drawing of a man's head and shoulders. The man has a large beard and mustache, curly hair covered by a cap, and is wearing a draped garment. The background is plain. The drawing appears to be done in pencil or charcoal on paper.

artworks.title: Saint Sebald Carrying the Model of His Church in Nuremberg
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with touches of red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a figure from the waist up. The person faces forward with their head slightly tilted downwards. They have long, gray, wavy hair and a beard. The person wears a hat with a small cross and an "X" design. They wear a robe with a voluminous sleeve on one arm. The person holds a staff in one hand and a model of a church or cathedral in the other hand. The background features a circular frame with decorative foliage. The composition is in sepia tone, with an ornate border around the central figure.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Catherine
artworks.creditLine: Rosenwald Collection
artworks.description: This image depicts a group of armored individuals engaged in a violent skirmish near a body of water. Above them, a tumultuous sky fills with dark clouds that seem to burst, casting streaks of light and debris downwards. In the background, there is a mountainous landscape with a distant castle or settlement. The figures' clothing and armor are detailed, and the natural elements are depicted with expressive lines, creating a sense of conflict and tension. The style is reminiscent of Albrecht Dürer.
